pivot.note: bottom-center, feet at about y=122 of 128

blink.note: Hold frame 0. Every 2.5-5.5 s (random) play half -> closed -> half -> open.

breathing.note: No video needed; scale the idle sprite vertically around the feet.

motion_sheet.note: Every motion starts and ends in the idle pose (eyes open), so it connects seamlessly to the idle.

rules: Stay in idle (breathing + blink) until the interval timer elapses.
Pick a random group from [read, guide, greet] and a random variant within the group (read and guide have A/B).
Do not pick the same group twice in a row.
After the motion ends, return to idle and restart the timer with interval +/- jitter.
Event overrides: greet on player approach, guide when dialogue starts.
